cases.authors: AEADataEditor; maintainer Lars Vilhuber; SSDE contributors
cases.institution: American Economic Association Data Editor / Social Science Data Editors
cases.why: Mature institutional template for running/assembling a replication package. Ships a generic runner (run.sh + config.yml), a Stata config.do (scenario A/B/C path resolution, ssc_packages declaration, author adopath), and an AI-agent skill (aea-replication-run) that encodes the actual replication workflow. Directly comparable to our scaffold + resolver + role orchestration.
cases.directory_structure: template/, ado/plus, automations/ (00_preliminaries/00_prepare_aux/00_unpack_zip), build/, tools/, docs/, generated/, tests/, .devcontainer, .github/workflows; top-level REPLICATION.md, run.sh, template-config.do, template-main.R, config.yml
cases.entry_point: run.sh (reads config.yml, finds main file by extension, runs Stata .do in batch via main log tail, or R CMD BATCH .R); author deposit's own master.do used when present
cases.data_stages: 00_unpack_zip -> deposit scan appendices -> data documentation in REPLICATION.md
cases.analysis_stages: Detect master file (grep ^do/^include in *.do); if none, build master.do; run each numbered program in author order; iterate on failures
cases.table_figure_generation: Master.do calls each program incl. table/figure scripts; goal: all figures/tables saved to disk; compare annotated screenshots from manuscript
cases.manuscript_integration: REPLICATION.md maps every figure/table to the program that produces it; compares against manuscript screenshots; Action Items split by manuscript vs openICPSR
cases.reproducibility_mechanism: Containerized Stata (devcontainer/init.sh); config.do declares every SSC package; scenario A/B/C resolves rootdir; fixed seeds; batch mode with .log/.Rout tail
cases.review_validation: AEA Data & Code Availability Policy (DCAP); pre-publication reproducibility check; REPLICATION.md Findings/Replication steps/Classification; aea-report-finalize consolidates tags
cases.human_decisions: Decide whether a master file already exists vs must be built; whether data are restricted and how to wire them; which packages to install; reconciling any numeric mismatch with manuscript; keeping builder scaffolding separate from author code
cases.automatable: detecting a master file (grep), installing declared SSC packages, running in batch mode, capturing stdout/log tail, recording numeric findings, checklist-fill
cases.adopt: (1) generic runner that resolves the main entry point by extension; (2) config.do pattern for env-dependent path/scenario + declared dependencies; (3) 'use the author's own master, don't replace it'; (4) 'don't wrap do in cap — stop at first failure'; (5) sentinel at the end to distinguish completed vs killed run
cases.not_generalize: AEA-specific Manuscript Central (MC) numbers, openICPSR deposit mechanics, editorial triage channels, jiraticket/bitbucket-pipelines references

cases.project: Tackling Psychosocial and Capital Constraints Opens Pathways out of Poverty (niger-asp-reprod)
cases.authors: Bossuroy, Goldstein, Karimou, Karlan, Kazianga, Premand, Thomas, Udry, Pariente, Vaillant, Wright
cases.institution: World Bank / DIME; published in Nature 2022
cases.why: A real, published paper's reproducibility repository on GitHub. Shows a real master do-file that orchestrates a multi-country, multi-round impact evaluation: user path branching, reviewer toggle, package install stage, phase/country globals, numbered analysis stages, and output organized by report type.
cases.data_stages: Data hosted externally in World Bank Microdata Library (catalog 4294); code reads raw data, cleaning scripts (01_GLOBAL_JOINT sets phase/country globals; data_management)
cases.analysis_stages: 06 regressions (per phase Followup/Followup_2), 07-08 baseline balance & attrition, 10-11 cost-benefit, 12-13 MHT, 15 psych-cost, 16 alpha; 04_my_programs holds reusable helpers (list_vars, label_vars, PAP tables, summary matrix)
cases.table_figure_generation: Output/NER/report_tables, report_graphs, report_stats; scripts named 07 (Table SI.1), 09 (Figure 2), 11 (Figure 3), 12 (Table SI.5), 14 (Figure SI.1)
cases.manuscript_integration: Script headers comment 'this script replicates Table SI.X / Figure X'; output folders mirror report sections
cases.reproducibility_mechanism: Single master do; reviewer global (1 = reviewer mode) switches path and reduces bootstrap repetitions (hpc_switch 5 vs 3000); set seed 2; timer for runtime; user-specific path branching in master; version 15.0
cases.review_validation: Reviewer mode is an explicit reproducibility switch; comments document expected runtime (step6 ~14min, step12 >24h); microdata catalog for data
cases.human_decisions: Set reviewer=1 and edit first two paths; choose HPC_switch on/off (full bootstrap vs reduced); comment/uncomment sections to run; verify restricted data access
cases.automatable: package detection/install (ssc/net per 01_PROGRAMS), master invokes sections, globals per country/phase, output folder creation
cases.adopt: (1) reviewer/reproducibility switch that reduces heavy computation (bootstrap reps) for a check run; (2) separate 01_PROGRAMS package-install stage; (3) numbered stage scripts with headers naming the table/figure; (4) global path branching by user; (5) documented runtime per heavy step
cases.not_generalize: Niger/Burkina/Senegal country-phase hardcoding, Dropbox data paths, specific survey/round names, mhtreg version workaround (Stata 15 vs 16 compiled mata)

cases.project: Adopting the Euro: a Synthetic Control Approach (Euro-SCM-Replication-EJPE)
cases.why: A real, published-consent replication repo that is folder-by-function (Text/Data/Code/Output) and multi-language (Stata + R + MATLAB), with a single Master.do acting as a control panel (globals for outcome/covariates/treatment dates/donor pool) and commented robustness blocks that re-run the pipeline with different settings.
cases.directory_structure: Text/ (TeX article), Data/ (raw), Code/ (Master.do, Paths.do, 0..9 numbered .do, analysis/Placebo_Country R scripts), Output/ (Figures/, Tables/)
cases.data_stages: 0_Data_Management_Annual takes raw data, cleans, merges multi-source data
cases.analysis_stages: 1_SCM_Annual (synthetic control estimation), 2_Aggregation_Annual (merge doppelganger), 3_Descriptives_Annual, 4_ComparisonTables_Annual, 7_SCM_2012, 8_SCM_1999; placebo country analysis in R
cases.manuscript_integration: Master.do comments name the figure/table each run produces (Figure 1, Table 1, Table A.2, ...); some results noted as ad-hoc computations (Figure 4, Table A.4)
cases.reproducibility_mechanism: Paths.do is the only per-machine edit (username-based path); Master.do is the global control panel (defines countries, outcome, covariates, treatment dates, donor pool, robustness toggles); fixed treatment dates; documented exclusions (Luxembourg, Greece)
cases.review_validation: Commented robustness blocks (in-time placebo, leave-one-out donor pool, alternative outcomes) re-run the pipeline; referee-check blocks for GNI/GDP variants; R code for in-space placebo
cases.human_decisions: Choose outcome/covariates/treatment dates/donor list; whether to include Luxembourg (excluded for some outcomes); whether to run placebo/leave-one-out; sample end year; ad-hoc computations (Figure 4, Table A.4) done outside code
cases.automatable: Given globals, the numerical pipeline (data mgmt -> SCM -> aggregation -> tables -> graphs) is deterministic; robustness blocks are parameterized re-runs
cases.adopt: (1) Master.do as a declarative 'control panel' of globals (outcome/covariates/treatment/donor); (2) folder-by-function (Text/Data/Code/Output); (3) Paths.do as the single per-machine path file; (4) commented robustness blocks that re-run the same pipeline with different settings; (5) cross-language split (Stata core + R for placebo)
cases.not_generalize: Synthetic-control-specific treatment-date and donor-pool globals; specific country codes; Dropbox username paths; MATLAB placeholders; ad-hoc computations left outside the pipeline

cases.authors: World Bank EduAnalytics team (Azevedo et al. 2019 policy research working paper)
cases.institution: World Bank Group, Education Global Practice
cases.why: A real World Bank analysis repo that is explicitly 'replicable by anyone', with a numbered task-folder convention (00_doc/01_data/02_sim/03_export_tables/04_repo_update/05_working_paper), per-task run.do entry points, a master run_all, a project profile do, and a documented GitHub branch/review workflow (master/develop/documentation/QA).
cases.entry_point: run_LearningPoverty.do (asserts profile loaded, then do's each task's run.do in order); profile_LearningPoverty.do must run first
cases.data_stages: TASK 01_DATA: builds learning poverty from multiple sources (harmonized GLAD, enrollment, proficiency, population)
cases.analysis_stages: TASK 02_SIMULATION: simulates learning poverty 2015-2030; TASK 03_EXPORT_TABLES; TASK 05_WORKINGPAPER exports figures/tables
cases.table_figure_generation: 03_export_tables and 05_working_paper export tables/figures; 04_repo_update creates csv files hosted in repo
cases.manuscript_integration: 05_working_paper exports figures/tables for the working paper; 00_documentation carries technical note explaining the measure
cases.reproducibility_mechanism: Entire repo is self-contained (code + raw data); requires R and Stata; each task has its own run.do; master run_all; README + repo-structure note with data flowcharts (mermaid)
cases.review_validation: QA branch creates a 'replicable' version of develop, tested, then merged; contribution conventions (BUG FIX prefix, squashed merge); master only on milestone; automated data flowcharts
cases.human_decisions: Which data sources/aggregation rules; restricted data access; whether to run simulation vs data-only; branch strategy and PR review by maintainers; documentation edits on a separate branch
cases.automatable: Numbered task orchestration (run_all), data flowcharts from repo structure, table/figure export, dataset documentation tables
cases.adopt: (1) numbered task folders each with its own run.do; (2) master run_all that asserts a project profile is loaded; (3) documentation folder with technical note + repo structure + data flowcharts + dataset tables; (4) a dedicated 'replicable QA branch' tested before milestone; (5) explicit contribution conventions (commit prefixes, squashed merge, micro-commit)
cases.not_generalize: Education/learning-poverty-specific measure; GLAD/UNESCO data sources; maintainer-specific push access; wb-gov branch naming (dnm / do_not_merge)

cases.project: Social Science Data Editors Template README
cases.authors: Lars Vilhuber, Miklos Koren, Joan Llull, Marie Connolly, Florian Oswald, Peter Morrow
cases.institution: Social Science Data Editors (endorsed by many social-science journals)
cases.why: A canonical institutional standard for the README of a replication package. Provides a machine-fillable schema for Data Availability & Provenance, rights/licenses, summary of availability, per-source details (format, data dictionary, availability, citation), computational requirements (software+version, packages+version, hardware, wall-clock), and separate data-preparation vs analysis instructions.
cases.directory_structure: template-README.md (annotated), templates/README.{docx,html,pdf,tex}, article.md, run_workflow.sh, Endorsers.md, Development.md, .github/workflows (release/publish)
cases.entry_point: template-README.md (the schema); run_workflow.sh builds the published site
cases.data_stages: Data Availability + Provenance Statements; per-data-source details (format, dictionary, availability, citation); Statement about Rights; License for Data
cases.analysis_stages: Instructions for Data Preparation and Analysis (separately); computational requirements; expected runtime
cases.table_figure_generation: (no code) — README maps each exhibit to data/code; note 'good package uses minimal automated scripts, no manual interventions unless absolutely unavoidable'
cases.manuscript_integration: README is the guide from data to every figure/table; DCAS goes beyond data citation to describe how to obtain data (cost, access, qualifications)
cases.reproducibility_mechanism: Standardized README structure so a replicator can immediately locate documents and reproduce results; software/package/hardware/runtime declarations
cases.review_validation: Endorsed by multiple journal data editors; used in AEA Data Editor reports; rights and data-availability boxes are checkable
cases.human_decisions: Choose licenses; certify distribution rights; select which data sources and their availability; decide confidentiality/redistribution; whether own-lab/experiment/survey provenance description applies
cases.automatable: Filling the structured sections (data table, availability checkboxes, computational requirements) once the facts are known; checking that README maps each exhibit to a program
cases.adopt: (1) README schema with Data Availability & Provenance + per-source details; (2) computational requirements (software/package versions, hardware, wall-clock) as a first-class section; (3) separate data-preparation vs analysis instructions; (4) data-rights/license disclosure; (5) 'minimal automated scripts, no manual interventions unless unavoidable' principle
cases.not_generalize: SSDE/AA-style journal endorsement list; legal/non-legal license guidance that is jurisdiction-specific; the exact checkbox wording for specific journals

cases.authors: DIME Analytics (Kristoffer Bjarkefur, Luiza Cardoso De Andrade)
cases.why: An institutional tool that encodes DIME's project-folder + master-do-file best practices in a command (iefolder), plus best-practice Do-file headers and reproducibility collaboration settings (ieboilstart). Strong model for our own scaffold: it auto-generates the project folder tree and keeps the master do-file updated while preserving manual edits.
cases.directory_structure: src/{ado/{iefolder,ieboilstart,iebaltab,ieddtab,...}, mdhlp, sthlp, tests}; README; reproot.yaml; CITATION.cff; CONTRIBUTING.md
cases.entry_point: iefolder new project -> DataWork + master do-file; iefolder new round/unitofobs/subfolder to extend
cases.data_stages: DataWork folder with DataWork/{Survey Round}/... and Encrypted folder; unit-of-observation master folders; Sampling subfolder for PII
cases.analysis_stages: Master do-files link to all main folders and are updated as rounds/units/subfolders are added; ieboilstart applies reproducibility collaboration best practices
cases.table_figure_generation: (tooling) — sets the folder/global convention that scripts use to emit outputs; ietoolkit includes iedbtab/iegraph for Diff-in-Diff tables/graphs
cases.manuscript_integration: Folder globals point scripts at output; master do-file organizes the whole DataWork pipeline
cases.reproducibility_mechanism: Standardized DataWork folder tree + auto-maintained master do-file; ieboilstart header applies best practices; ssc install from repo
cases.review_validation: Tests under src/tests; help files justify the DIME best practice behind each command
cases.human_decisions: Choose project/round/unit-of-observation/sampling structure; decide encrypted vs public folders; when to add new rounds/units
cases.automatable: Folder creation, master do-file generation/update, globals wiring, placeholder gitkeep via iegitaddmd
cases.adopt: (1) a scaffold command that generates a project/task folder tree + a master runner and keeps it updated; (2) deterministic globals for paths (Data/Output/etc.); (3) a standard Do-file header (ieboilstart) that encodes reproducibility collaboration settings; (4) explicit encrypted vs public folder separation for PII/restricted data
cases.not_generalize: Impact-evaluation survey-round structure (DataWork/Encrypted), DIME-specific unit-of-observation folders, the exact folder names

cases.why: A mature, broad per-journal skill library that decomposes the whole manuscript lifecycle into named stage-skills and a 'router' skill. Directly analogous to our role/capability mapping: e.g. AEJ-Macro has aejmac-workflow (router), aejmac-topic-selection, literature-positioning, identification, theory-model, robustness, tables-figures, writing-style, replication-package, referee-strategy, submission, rebuttal — plus a one-click 00_master.do skeleton.
cases.directory_structure: <Journal>-Skills/{skills/<stage>-<name>/SKILL.md, resources/code/{stata, r, python, ...}}; e.g. AEJ-Macroeconomics-Skills/skills/{aejmac-workflow, aejmac-identification, ..., aejmac-replication-package, aejmac-submission, aejmac-rebuttal}; Annual-Review-of-Economics-Skills/resources/code/stata/00_master.do
cases.table_figure_generation: 09_tables.do exports final tables/figures to output/; aejmac-tables-figures skill for IRFs, fan charts, model-fit exhibits
cases.manuscript_integration: aejmac-writing-style (abstract/intro last, <=100-word abstract); aejmac-literature-positioning; aejmac-submission (AEA system preflight); aejmac-rebuttal (R&R response)
cases.reproducibility_mechanism: 00_master.do pins Stata version, sets seed, declares root/raw/clean/tables/figs globals, lists one-time ssc installs, runs ordered 01..09; aejmac-replication-package skill encodes AEA DCAP (pin toolchain, seeds, cached intermediates + reduced-scale switch, numerical-accuracy artifacts)
cases.review_validation: aejmac-referee-strategy, aejmac-robustness, aejmac-replication-package (AEA Data Editor pre-publication check), aejmac-submission
cases.human_decisions: Choose which branch (empirical vs quantitative/theory); when to lock the question before method; whether to run placebo/robustness variants; how to respond to R&R; model/spec selection
cases.automatable: The 00_master.do chain (clean->desc->did/iv/rdd/dml->mechanism->robustness->tables) given fixed spec; package install block; seed pinning; checklist fill; router dispatch by symptom
cases.adopt: (1) 'router' skill that maps a current-symptom/bottleneck to the next stage-skill (the model for our orchestrator); (2) one-click 00_master.do skeleton with numbered pipeline and a sentinel message; (3) decompose the lifecycle into stage-skills each with checklist + anti-patterns; (4) journal-specific reproducibility skill encoding DCAP (pin versions, seeds, reduced-scale switch, cached intermediates)
cases.not_generalize: Per-journal formatting/submission specifics (AEA system, membership fees, JEL codes), per-journal abstract-length rules, macro-specific DSGE/HANK solver scope
